Package bg.tu_varna.ks.command.events

package bg.tu_varna.ks.command.events
Commands that operate on events in the calendar.

Contains commands for booking and cancelling meetings, viewing and searching, workload statistics, marking holidays, finding free slots and merging calendars: Book, Unbook, Agenda, Change, Find, Holiday, BusyDays, FindSlot, FindSlotWith, Merge.

  • Class
    Description
    Agenda
    Command that prints all events scheduled for a given date, in chronological order.
    Book
    Command that books (schedules) a new event in the currently opened calendar.
    BusyDays
    Command that prints workload statistics between two dates.
    Change
    Command that modifies a single field of an existing event.
    Find
    Command that searches for events whose name or note contains a given substring.
    FindSlot
    Command that finds the earliest free time slot of at least a given duration on a specific date.
    FindSlot.Slot
    Lightweight description of a free time slot in the calendar.
    FindSlotWith
    Command that finds a free slot common to two calendars (the current one and another one specified as a file).
    Holiday
    Command that marks a given date as a non-working day (holiday).
    Merge
    Command that merges events from an external calendar file into the current calendar.
    Unbook
    Command that cancels (removes) an existing event from the calendar.
